title: 高電圧パルスパワー工学
subtitle: High-Voltage Pulsed Power Engineering
keywords: Electric field strength 2.Pre-breakdown phenomena 3.Dielectric breakdown 4.Application of HV 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: Students will (1) learn dielectric and electrical insulation phenomena in gas, liquid and solid. (2) learn how to generate AC, DC, and Impulse voltage. (3) learn how to measure high voltage and high current. (4) learn various high voltage testing.
advice: Course description 1. Electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation 2. Elementary physics of electrical discharge 3. Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in gas 4. Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in liquid and solid dielectrics 5. Generation of various high voltages, measurement of high voltages and high currents, high voltage insulation test techniques 6. Application of high-voltage and pulsed power engineering Expectations To understand the lecture well, knowledge about “electromagnetics (electrostatic fields)”, “electrical machinery (transformer)” and “transient phenomena in liner circuits” are required.
books: Textbook: Fundamentals of high voltage engineering, ISBN: 9784817302380 (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: This course is strongly related with the following courses: “Electromagnetics (Electrostatics)”, “Transient Phenomena in Linear Circuits”, and “Electrical Machinery (Transformer)”. It’s necessary to review the basic knowledge obtained from those related courses in advance.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate the electrical field strength by analytical formula derived from Gauss's law
Be able to understand the kinetics of charged particles and to explain elementary physics of electrical discharg
Be able to understand the Townsend breakdown theory, Paschen's law, and streamer theory in gas.
Be able to understand the electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in liquid and solid dielectrics.
Be able to understand the AC, DC and impulse voltage generator, and insulation test techniques.
Be able to explain the application of high-voltage and pulsed power engineering.

achievementLevels.ideal: To achieve the program targets listed above up to the level which is sufficient to teach other students.
achievementLevels.standard: To achieve the program targets listed above.

lessons.content: [Guidance] *Explanation of syllabus. [Introduction of high-voltage pulsed power engineering] [Electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation 1] *Uniform and non-uniform electrostatic fields
lessons.assignments: *To understand electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation.

lessons.content: [Electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation 2] *Uniform and non-uniform electrostatic fields in multi-dielectric isotropic materials
lessons.assignments: *To understand electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation in multi- dielectric isotropic materials.

lessons.content: [Elementary physics of electrical discharge 1] *Number density *Thermal motion of particles *Drift velocity *Similarity law
lessons.assignments: To understand elementary physics of electrical discharge.

lessons.content: [Elementary physics of electrical discharge 2] *Generation and extinction of charged particles *Electron emission from metal electrodes
lessons.assignments: To understand elementary physics of electrical discharge.

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] [Quiz 1] *Evaluation targets are the class number 1 to 4. *Self-check of understanding level
lessons.assignments: To review the contents of the lecture 1 to 4

lessons.content: [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in gas 1] *Townsend breakdown theory *Townsend coefficient (α) *Secondary electron emission coefficient (γ) *Townsend's criterion
[Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in gas 2] *Paschen’s law *Meek criterion of streamer formation *Features of self-sustaining discharges (corona discharge, glow discharge, arc discharge)
lessons.assignments: To understand Paschen's law, Meek criterion of streamer formation, and features of self-sustaining discharges.

lessons.content: [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in gas 3] *Lightning impulse voltage, switching impulse voltage *V-t curve *Lightning stroke *Vacuum discharge *High frequency discharge *High pressure discharge *Creeping discharge *Dielectric barrier discharge *Observation techniques for optical emission from electrical discharges
lessons.assignments: To understand impulse voltages, V-t curve, lightning stroke, various types of electrical discharges and observation techniques.

lessons.content: Self-reflection class] [Examination 1] *Evaluation of the achievement level of program objectives 1 to 3
lessons.assignments: To review the contents of the lecture 1 to 8.

lessons.content: [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in liquid and solid dielectrics 1] *Electrical breakdown phenomena in liquid dielectrics *Theories of electrical breakdown in liquid dielectrics
lessons.assignments: To understand (1) the electrical conduction phenomena in uniform and non-uniform electrostatics fields, and (2) the difference between electronic breakdown theory and bubble breakdown theory.

lessons.content: [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in liquid and solid dielectrics 2] *Electrical breakdown phenomena in solid dielectrics *Theories of electrical breakdown in solid dielectrics
lessons.assignments: To understand (1) dielectric polarization and dielectric loss, (2) electrical conduction phenomena in solid dielectrics, (3) mechanisms of intrinsic, avalanche and thermal breakdown in solid dielectrics, and (4) partial discharges and treeing phenomena.

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] [Quiz 2] *Evaluation targets are class number 11 and 12. *Self-check of understanding level
lessons.assignments: To review the contents of the lecture 11 and 12.

lessons.content: [Generation of high voltages] *AC high voltage *DC high voltage *Impulse voltage [Measurement of high voltages and high currents] *probe, divider, shunt, CT [High voltage insulation test techniques] *Non-destructive test *Withstand voltage test *Breakdown voltage test
lessons.assignments: To understand how to generate various types of high voltage, how to measure high voltage and high current, and various types of insulation test.

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] *Self-check of understanding level * Questionnaire of the lecture [Examination 2] *Evaluation of the achievement level of program objectives
lessons.assignments: To review the contents of the lecture 10 and 13

lessons.content: [Application of high voltage and pulsed power engineering] *Electrostatic precipitator (ESP) *Copying machine *Electrostatic separation *Ozone generator *Gas circuit breaker (GCB) *Electron microscope (SEM, TEM) *Electro-hydro dynamic (EHD) [Self-check lecture] *Explanation of results evaluation method *Notice of evaluation results *Questionnaire of the lecture
lessons.assignments: To understand application of high voltage.
